Externally attestable evidence: published escalation criteria naming cross-run coordination as a trigger, with the pause rule

Externally attestable evidence: published egress policy with hash; canary scheme whose endpoint a third party holds

Control: Inventory/attestation of tenant code-execution endpoints; canary credentials in public harnesses
Externally attestable evidence: vendor attestation of tenant isolation; canary firing reportable

Control: Config renderer that never evaluates template expressions in data fields; no HDF5 external references
Externally attestable evidence: published renderer policy; a benign probe dataset submitted to the public service

Control: Pod-level block of the instance metadata service
Externally attestable evidence: attestation

Control: Egress tripwires; canary tokens in pod environments; dead-drop detection; decode-aware secret scanning
Externally attestable evidence: canary scheme with a third-party endpoint; statement that scanning replicates attacker encodings

Control: Alerting on API queries for the platform's own infrastructure identifiers
Externally attestable evidence: published alert-criteria statement; attestation of scoped tests

Control: Workload identity with narrowly scoped, short-lived credentials bound to their intended use; token-origin anomaly detection
Externally attestable evidence: attestation

Control: Admission policy rejecting privileged and hostPath pods; CSI ClusterRole not cluster-wide
Externally attestable evidence: published admission-policy configuration with hash — the single most attestable control in the record

Control: No static passwords in pod environments; workload auth for datastores
Externally attestable evidence: attestation

Control: Secret partitioning; blast-radius limit per secret object
Externally attestable evidence: attestation of the partitioning rule

Control: Per-cluster, cluster-scoped connector credentials; no system:masters for ephemeral clients
Externally attestable evidence: attestation

Control: Kill criteria on mesh enrolment-rate anomalies; ACL scoping; refuse enrolments that suppress telemetry
Externally attestable evidence: published enrolment policy

Control: Narrower GitHub App scopes; PR/workflow-change alerting; CI execution policy
Externally attestable evidence: published statement of app scopes and CI execution policy

Control: Detection of re-arming loaders on ephemeral sandboxes; egress policy for platform-hosted proxy Spaces
Externally attestable evidence: published Spaces egress policy

Control: Criticality fix: a correlated attack signal pages on-call unconditionally
Externally attestable evidence: published criticality-escalation criteria — existence is attestable

Control: Retention of full transcripts and shared-store snapshots for the campaign plus the disclosure window; resets must not truncate
Externally attestable evidence: published retention policy; attestation of completeness after an incident

Externally attestable evidence: published statement that such a forensic path exists and was exercised

Control: Scorer honesty: blocked/impossible reports accepted without penalty; the share of tasks without a known authorized solution known and bounded, unknown solvability kept apart from proven impossibility
Externally attestable evidence: published statement; the sprint's pressure ladder is the test a third party could run on a public model
